_batch: Phase 2 batch 6 — uncovered types, FULL checklists
_note: DRAFTED, A through E. Universal core imported identically; only the type-common band is written here.
subject: VRF SYSTEM
source_master: DRAFTED — no master. This type had no start-up checklist at all.

items.label: Manufacturer's IOM start-up steps reviewed, completed & attached
Permits and authority approvals in place; prerequisites to start satisfied
Installation complete and matches the approved shop drawing
Nameplate data recorded and reconciled against the design
items.note: The nameplate block above is the record; this row is the act of comparing it to what was specified.

items.label: Electrical terminations torqued and verified; circuit labelled and breaker sized to nameplate
Alignment and lubrication complete per the IOM; reports attached where required
System cleaned, flushed and free of construction debris
Safety devices installed and set BEFORE any energization
items.note: The gate the whole section exists for: a protective device set after first start protected nothing.

items.label: Area clear, guards in place, no hot work in progress
items.note: Universal across every type in the corpus and every source the firm has, but carried by no code in the anchor set. Cited as firm practice and classed universal on that basis — the convergence is real, the citation is ours.

items.label: Refrigerant piping length, branch controllers and indoor units addressed per the approved layout
Refrigerant charge calculated for the actual pipe run and recorded
items.note: A VRF system is charged for its installed geometry; the calculation is what makes the charge defensible.

items.label: Refrigerant leak detection and machine-room provisions verified where required
Isolate and lock out all energy sources; confirm zero energy at the unit
items.note: Universal across every type in the corpus and every source the firm has, but carried by no code in the anchor set. Cited as firm practice and classed universal on that basis — the convergence is real, the citation is ours.

items.label: Energize control circuit only; verify display, no faults, correct firmware
Verify rotation correct before the unit is brought to load
Restore energy; first start under supervision, observing the IOM sequence
Return to standby cleanly and confirm the unit restarts on demand
Runs at steady state without alarm, trip or abnormal noise
Controls hold setpoint under load without short-cycling
No leaks at any joint disturbed during installation or start-up
items.note: Universal across every type in the corpus and every source the firm has, but carried by no code in the anchor set. Cited as firm practice and classed universal on that basis — the convergence is real, the citation is ours.

items.label: Each indoor unit responds to its own call in both heating and cooling
High / low pressure protection proven at the outdoor unit
Refrigerant leak detection alarm proven where fitted
items.note: Proven individually here. The integrated response is IST scope, per the known-good-handoff boundary — a start-up hands the integrated test a known-good starting position, it does not duplicate it.

items.label: Compressor protection — discharge temperature and oil return proven
Total refrigerant charge, factory plus field (kg)
Suction and discharge pressure at the outdoor unit (kPa)
Indoor unit count online vs the design layout
Amp draw per phase at the outdoor unit (A)

_ratification_note: Batches 6-8 ratified as drafted, no amendments. Passive-emitter thinness and the life-safety known-good-handoff boundary both applied as pre-ruled.
